Start the lab — you get temp credentials + a URL like student-XXXX.looker.com or qwiklabs-XXXX.looker.com (BOTH in scope as *.looker.com!) 4. Login as admin 5. title: A2A protocol endpoint probe — agent manifest + unauthenticated task submission
instruction: Google A2A protocol uses /.well-known/agent.json to expose agent capabilities. Wiz AI uses A2A for agent-to-agent comms. Test: 1. GET /.well-known/agent.json → reveals capabilities, input/output schemas, auth requirements. 2. POST /tasks/send with unauthenticated payload → check if task accepted. 3. If auth is optional or uses API key → test for IDOR across task IDs. Run wiz-no-cred-probe.sh Phase 4 first, then follow up based on results.
commands: curl -sk -X POST https://a2a.eu1.test.wiz.io/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tasks/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"type":"text","text":"test"}]}},"id":1}' | python3 -m json.tool
expected_output: Agent manifest exposed OR unauthenticated task submission accepted
unlocks: A2A unauthenticated access → potential data exfil via agent task responses (High/Critical)
